title: DreamStation 1 PE-PUR foam recall
shortDescription: Original DreamStation included in 2021 voluntary recall.
fullDescription:
Philips recalled DreamStation 1 (and other devices) due to PE-PUR sound-abatement foam degradation that could release particles into the airpath. Continue therapy only with physician guidance and register for replacement DreamStation 2.

Not a fault code — but a critical safety notice.

fixSteps.title: Speak to physician
fixSteps.instruction: Decision to continue/pause therapy is medical.

fixSteps.title: Await DreamStation 2 replacement
fixSteps.instruction: Philips ships replacement at no charge.

faq.a: Only with physician guidance — untreated apnea has its own risks.

title: DreamStation pressure sensor error
shortDescription: Internal pressure transducer out of calibration.
fullDescription:
E-13 indicates the pressure sensor is reading outside its valid range — often after a tubing block, water aspiration, or sensor drift. Power cycle clears transient cases; persistent E-13 needs DME service.

Verify tubing is clear and not full of water.

fixSteps.title: Disconnect tubing
fixSteps.instruction: Remove tube; check no water in machine outlet.

whenToCallPro: If error persists after dry power cycle.

title: DreamStation blower failure
fullDescription:
E-15 is the blower controller seeing the rotor stalled or below target RPM. Common causes are a clogged inlet filter or the bearing failing after 5+ years of use.

Replace the inlet filter first; if E-15 persists, the blower needs swap.

fixSteps.title: Replace inlet filter
fixSteps.instruction: Slide out rear filter; insert new ultra-fine.

fixSteps.title: DME repair
fixSteps.instruction: Blower replacement only at authorised service.

whenToCallPro: If filter swap doesn't clear E-15.

title: Heated tube communication error
shortDescription: DreamStation can't talk to heated hose.
fullDescription:
E-22 means the device can't read the heated tube's resistance signal. Most often the tube is unseated at the machine outlet, or contacts are corroded.

Reseat tube firmly; if contacts green, replace tube.

fixSteps.title: Detach and reseat
fixSteps.instruction: Pull off tube and push back firmly.

fixSteps.title: Inspect contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Look for green/white corrosion at tube cuff.

faq.a: Yes, but disable heated tube setting in menu first.

title: Humidifier heater plate not detected
fullDescription:
E-25 indicates the humidifier heater base is missing or its NTC has failed. Check water tank seated; ensure machine is fully docked into humidifier base.

If docked correctly, the heater base needs service.

fixSteps.title: Reseat tank
fixSteps.instruction: Lift, inspect for water under tank, reseat firmly.

whenToCallPro: If error persists with tank reseated.

faq.a: Yes — disable humidifier in settings to dry-mode.

title: SD card unreadable
shortDescription: DreamStation can't read therapy data card.
fullDescription:
E-31 occurs when SD card is corrupted, formatted incorrectly, or wrong size. DreamStation requires FAT32 ≤32GB. Format card with PC, eject and retry.

Usage continues without card — but DME can't pull therapy data.

fixSteps.title: Replace card
fixSteps.instruction: If still bad, use new SanDisk Industrial 8GB.

title: DreamStation 2 service indicator
fullDescription:
E-66 lights at the manufacturer-defined service hours (typically 30,000). Therapy continues but DME should run the diagnostic and reset the counter.

Not user-resettable.

title: Humidifier water low
fullDescription:
Water-droplet icon flashes when tank below ~50ml. Top up with distilled water — never tap, scale will damage the plate.

Not a fault.

fixSteps.title: Refill tank
fixSteps.instruction: Use distilled water to MAX line.

faq.a: Tap minerals scale the heater plate over months.

title: Mask leak alert
fullDescription:
DreamStation flags MASK-LEAK when measured leak exceeds 24 L/min for prolonged time. Adjust headgear, replace cushion, or check tubing connections.

Not a device fault.

fixSteps.title: Tighten headgear evenly
fixSteps.instruction: Snug both straps, not too tight.

fixSteps.title: Try chin strap
fixSteps.instruction: If full-face still leaks at mouth.

whenToCallPro: If leak persists with new cushion.

title: DreamMapper won't connect
fullDescription:
DreamStation 2 uses BLE to sync to DreamMapper. Pairing fails when location permission is off, phone has stale pair, or the device's Bluetooth radio crashed (rare).

Reboot phone Bluetooth, forget pair, re-pair.
whenToCallPro: If repeated re-pair fails — device service.

faq.a: Yes — app is for adherence tracking only.

title: E15 — recall
fullDescription: DreamStation recall service required. Common diagnostic on Philips CPAP cpap. Resolve by following manufacturer service procedure.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Clean charging contacts or ports with soft cloth.

whenToCallPro: If reset/charge doesn't fix, contact warranty service.

faq.a: Most personal care devices have 1-2 year warranty.
Cleaning and reset usually fix common issues.
